children: Hawkeye Digital, Inc. reported a net loss of $(572,893) for fiscal 2026 on no operating revenue, compared with a net loss of $(523,327) in fiscal 2025 and no revenue in the prior year.
Revenue was $0 for FY 2026 and $0 for FY 2025 (no operating revenue recognized in either year).
Net income (loss) was a loss of $(572,893) for FY 2026, compared with a loss of $(523,327) for FY 2025 (worsened by $(49,566)).
Diluted EPS was a loss per share of $(0.02) for FY 2026 and $(0.06) for FY 2025.
No operating revenue in FY 2026 or FY 2025; management noted an expected roughly $600K in advisory revenue after year-end under a letter of intent.
The company is shifting its strategy toward merchant-banking and investment activities and is evaluating an acquisition of a broker-dealer to support that transition.
Hawkeye Digital began R&D and increased professional services spending to implement the strategic plan and initiated R&D and advisory expenditures.
Management has extended at-will offers to build an investment and advisory team with approximately $900K of annualized salaries; cash payments are deferred pending fundraising.
The company entered an advisory engagement and issued warrants to support capital raising and strategic execution.
